title: hypericum maculatum subsp. immaculatum
intro: Hypericum maculatum subsp. immaculatum, commonly known as Spotted St. John's Wort, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the St. John's Wort family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat anxiety, insomnia, and depression. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum maculatum subsp. immaculatum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and naphthodianthrones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
